note: Uganda: work on a short contract takes the Directorate of Citizenship and Immigration Control's Special Pass, applied for online with the contract and the engaging company's covering letter, US$400 for three months; longer work takes a work permit. No days without one.

sources.title: Directorate of Citizenship and Immigration Control (Uganda), Special Pass
sources.said: This is a temporary pass that allows one to work on short contract, obtain medical treatment, tourism and exploring business opportunities etc. ... USD 400 for 3 months
